rounds.notes: I take thread the needle as my main power most games because it has the potential to give you the most value in the early game. However an argument can be made fore seekerpoint and seismic shot. I do recommend taking seismic shot 1st if you aren't confident in your aim. Seekerpoint is better 1st if they are playing reaper and genji with a mobile tank and supports. The starting items I have I have found to be the most successful in keeping me alive for the 1st round. You really just want to farm damage and not die round 1. You can take plasma converter instead of weapon grease if you feel like you need the extra survivability.

Torniquet is 100% Freja's best item, it gives you 50 overhealth anytime you updraft with helps you to stay safer when using it and not only that it resets your dash, so a good habit to get into is using your dash before using updraft once you have this item. It makes your roll outs faster too; dash, updraft, dash, and dash again. I am usually one of the 1st people to point on my team. If your team got destroyed in round one and you have enough cash without selling anything you can take some of the survival items I suggested instead of icy coolant. Ironclad exhaust ports+ plasma converter is my favorite for survival because it allows you to be aggressive and still live, also you get a ton of over health with torniquet. If you yourself are dying a lot take electrolytes and winning attitude and try to kill them with your ult right click combo. Also if you have room and the enemy team has 2+ people with bounties and/ or people that almost have bounties hunter's mark is an amazing item to help you come back and get a lot of stadium cash. Also the information is so valuable for your team because they can see the revealed people as well.

For powers you can take seekerpoint or seismic shot. Seekerpoint allows the 1shot thought it isn't as consistent due to the small explosion radius but it is possible to do. It usually happens when you head shot them and they back up into the 2nd explosion. I have found that seismic shot is better against barrier tanks and genji because you can shoot it at their feet and hit them for anyone that isn't Zayra (Rein has to walk over it). Otherwise you can use it to have them carry the explosion to their teammates.  Seekerpont gets no value if it hits a shield so potential value is better than nothing. Take hunter's mark if your team is behind and they have bounties it is an amazing comeback item (look at round 2 notes for more context on this item). Talon modification is ideal but you can take anything in the optional items if you don't have enough for it. Salvaged slugs is worth it if you have enough cash and they have a rein/ zarya that is being a problem and no one else on your team can deal with them. That with shieldbuster and ammo reserves your primary fire can destroy their shields reasonably fast at this point. I suggest just ignoring the tank until the supports and dps on their team are dead, if possible. On a side note slipstream scarf can help when hitscan characters to help you dodge and it can help you to get away. Also if you don't input a direction when dashing you dash straight up and you can use this combined with jump to get to high ground or use it like a mini updraft.

If you took hunter's mark and won the round then sell it otherwise if you are still losing pick it up or keep it. (Make sure the enemy team has bounties or almost has them otherwise it is a waste of cash). At this point you should be able to buy eye of the spider, it gives more consistent value and makes the one-shot more reliable compared to the closer. Though if you are just off to getting it then the closer is an acceptable replacement. If you can't get either then get hard light accelerator, and if you can't get that then get weapon jammer or codebreaker. As per usual if you can't stay alive then consider getting survival items and not being in the air as much.

By now the build should be fully online, take seismic shot or seekerpoint depending on which one you didn't take. Get the closer and congrats your take aim headshots now one-shot (ideally other factors) however I still suggest to fire your primary fire at them as well so you can guarantee the kill. Also your ult+ take aim will team wipe depending on how many of them you hit with it and your take aim. You should know the drill at this point if they have bounties take hunter's mark, take items to counter the enemy team if you don't have enough cash for the closer, and take survival items if you are struggling to live. If you are carrying your team and feel like you are dying too much consider phantasmic flux, it makes you very hard to kill without tanking your damage scaling. Also you can consider getting the forager power instead of seismic shot (get it round 7 instead) for more survivability and it also pairs well with phantasmic flux. Also the ap isn't entirely useless on her because you get your ult so fast and it will do more damage.

Hardlight accelerator is a very good item to round out the build it has very good synergy with Freja and gives her the much welcomed cd reduction plus up to 15% extra weapon power just from using abilities. Tourniquet also helps with the uptime of this item, you could also consider selling it at this point however it suggest against it unless it is a much needed epic. Portable zipline also helps with this item though it isn't as valuable after the nerf. This is the last round where hunter's mark could be useful, but at this point just take something that will give you more damage and/or more survivability. It is useful if they have flanking genji and/or reaper with a bounty so you and your team know where they are and can deny their flanks preemptively. Look at the optional items for counters/ survival items depending on your situation or if you don't have enough cash.

At this point your build is already complete you can get whatever power you want. I suggest redux for more hardlight uptime and forager for survivability. I have been experimenting with cyclone, it technically is more damage however it is awkward to use sometimes. Just get items from the optional items to fill out your build if you don't have enough for the suggested build. Also you can consider selling tourniquet for an epic item if you have enough cash. I suggest phantasmic flux, because it takes the place of giving you over health and survivability. Just note that you are going to have less uptime on hardlight accelerator.
